selection_rule.A: Maximize valid pixel count, then minimize squared distance between window center and image center (0.5W,0.5H), then y, then x.
selection_rule.B: Exclude windows with positive-area overlap with A; maximize valid pixel count, then minimize squared distance to fixed upper-right quarter point (0.75W,0.25H), then y, then x.
selection_rule.timing: All 20 coordinates are committed in visual_selection.json before any prediction is loaded.
